```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(knitr); knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
raw <- read.csv("asimplied.csv", check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
dep <- format(strptime(raw$SOBT, "%d-%m-%Y %H:%M"), "%H%M")
corpus <- data.frame(flight=raw[["Flight Designator"]], n=raw[["S.no"]], route=raw[["Routing"]],
                     dest=raw[["dest_iata"]], cap=raw[["Seats"]], dep=dep,
                     code=trimws(raw[["Airline code"]]), gha=trimws(raw[["GHA"]]), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
corpus <- corpus[order(corpus$n), ]
LF <- 1
depmin <- as.integer(substr(corpus$dep,1,2))*60L + as.integer(substr(corpus$dep,3,4))
YMAX <- 800
EMEAN <- 150.0; TLO <- -61.5; THI <- 361.5
fden <- function(t) dnorm(t, 150, 60)
gfl  <- function(tau, D, cp) cp*10*LF*( fden(D-tau) + fden(D-tau-1440) + fden(D-tau+1440) )
hhmm <- function(m){ m <- ((round(m) %% 1440) + 1440) %% 1440; sprintf("%02d%02d", m %/% 60L, m %% 60L) }
xlab1 <- function(v) if (v == 1440) "2400" else hhmm(v)

# airline colours
fixed_col <- c(AI="#D62728", `6E`="#2E2E9E", QP="#F57C00", UA="#4F9FE0")
ord <- names(sort(tapply(depmin, corpus$code, median)))
airline_col <- setNames(character(length(ord)), ord); gi <- 0L
for (a in ord){ if (a %in% names(fixed_col)){ airline_col[a] <- fixed_col[[a]] } else { h <- (47+gi*137.508)%%360; airline_col[a] <- hsv(h/360,0.65,0.70); gi <- gi+1L } }
air_name <- setNames(sprintf("airc%d", seq_along(ord)), ord)
rank_air <- names(sort(tapply(corpus$cap, corpus$code, sum), decreasing=TRUE)); LEG_CAP <- 20L
emit_air_defs <- function() for (a in names(air_name)) cat(sprintf("\\definecolor{%s}{HTML}{%s}\n", air_name[[a]], toupper(substr(airline_col[[a]],2,7))))
legend_air <- function(){ show <- rank_air[seq_len(min(length(rank_air),LEG_CAP))]
  cat("\\par\\vspace{3pt}{\\centering\\scriptsize\n")
  cat(paste(sprintf("\\textcolor{%s}{\\rule[-0.2ex]{1.6ex}{1.6ex}}\\,%s", air_name[show], show), collapse="\\quad{}"))
  if (length(rank_air)>LEG_CAP) cat(sprintf("\\quad{}(+%d more)", length(rank_air)-LEG_CAP)); cat("\\par}\n") }

# GHA colours
gha_pal <- c("AISATS"="#2C6FBB","BFS"="#C0392B","Ramp 360"="#27936B","AIESL"="#E08A1E")
ordg <- names(sort(tapply(depmin, corpus$gha, median)))
gha_hex <- vapply(ordg, function(g) if (g %in% names(gha_pal)) gha_pal[[g]] else "#666666", "")
names(gha_hex) <- ordg; gha_name <- setNames(sprintf("ghac%d", seq_along(ordg)), ordg)
rank_gha <- names(sort(tapply(corpus$cap, corpus$gha, sum), decreasing=TRUE))
emit_gha_defs <- function() for (g in names(gha_name)) cat(sprintf("\\definecolor{%s}{HTML}{%s}\n", gha_name[[g]], toupper(substr(gha_hex[[g]],2,7))))
legend_gha <- function(){ show <- rank_gha
  cat("\\par\\vspace{3pt}{\\centering\\scriptsize\n")
  cat(paste(sprintf("\\textcolor{%s}{\\rule[-0.2ex]{1.6ex}{1.6ex}}\\,%s", gha_name[show], show), collapse="\\quad{}")); cat("\\par}\n") }
legend_txt <- function(txt) cat("\\par\\vspace{3pt}{\\centering\\scriptsize \\textcolor{black}{\\rule[0.35ex]{2.6ex}{1.1pt}}\\,", txt, "\\par}\n", sep="")

draw_axes <- function(x0,x1,Wcm,Hcm,ymax,ystep,xticks,xlabs){
  sx <- Wcm/(x1-x0); sy <- Hcm/ymax
  cat(sprintf("\\draw[->] (0,0) -- (%.3f,0);\n", Wcm+0.4))
  cat(sprintf("\\draw[->] (0,0) -- (0,%.3f);\n", Hcm+0.4))
  for (v in seq(0,ymax,ystep)){ yy <- v*sy
    cat(sprintf("\\draw (-0.07,%.3f) -- (0.07,%.3f);\n", yy, yy))
    cat(sprintf("\\node[left,font=\\footnotesize] at (-0.10,%.3f) {%d};\n", yy, as.integer(v))) }
  for (k in seq_along(xticks)){ xx <- (xticks[k]-x0)*Wcm/(x1-x0)
    cat(sprintf("\\draw (%.3f,-0.07) -- (%.3f,0.07);\n", xx, xx))
    cat(sprintf("\\node[below,font=\\footnotesize] at (%.3f,-0.07) {%s};\n", xx, xlabs[k])) }
}
```

```{r v, results='asis'}
panel <- function(W0,W1,lab){
  span <- W1-W0; xstep <- if (span<=480) 60L else if (span<=720) 120L else 180L
  Wcm <- 15.5; Hcm <- 7.0; sx <- Wcm/span; sy <- Hcm/YMAX
  xc <- function(m)(m-W0)*sx; yc <- function(v)v*sy
  xticks <- seq(W0,W1,by=xstep); xlabs <- vapply(xticks,xlab1,"")
  cat("\\begin{figure}[H]\n\\centering\n\\begin{tikzpicture}\n")
  draw_axes(W0,W1,Wcm,Hcm,YMAX,100,xticks,xlabs)
  gstep <- max(1L, as.integer(round(span/240))); grid <- seq(W0,W1,by=gstep)
  for (g in ord) {
    idx <- which(corpus$code==g); if (length(idx)==0) next
    S <- rep(0,length(grid)); for (j in idx) S <- S + gfl(grid, depmin[j], corpus$cap[j])
    S <- pmin(S,YMAX); if (max(S)<0.5) next
    col <- "black"
    pts <- paste(sprintf("(%.3f,%.3f)",xc(grid),yc(S)),collapse=" ")
    cat(sprintf("\\draw[color=%s,opacity=0.8,line width=0.6pt] plot coordinates {%s};\n", col, pts))
  }
  cat("\\end{tikzpicture}\n")
  legend_txt("N3, one airline (flights summed)")
  cat(sprintf("\\caption{N3 stacked entry-time load by airline, %s.}\n", lab))
  cat("\\end{figure}\n\\clearpage\n")
}
for (k in 0:5) panel(k*240L,(k+1)*240L, sprintf("%s to %s (4 h window)", hhmm(k*240L), xlab1((k+1)*240L)))
for (k in 0:2) panel(k*480L,(k+1)*480L, sprintf("%s to %s (8 h window)", hhmm(k*480L), xlab1((k+1)*480L)))
for (k in 0:1) panel(k*720L,(k+1)*720L, sprintf("%s to %s (12 h window)", hhmm(k*720L), xlab1((k+1)*720L)))
panel(0L,1440L,"0000 to 2400 (24 h, full day)")
```
